factors.name: Audit scope mismatch
factors.description: Check whether the commit SHA cited in the audit report matches the bytecode deployed at the production proxy/implementation address.

factors.name: Audit recency
factors.description: Measure the number of days between today and the sign-off date of the most recent audit report covering the currently-deployed bytecode.

factors.name: Resolved-without-proof findings
factors.description: Count the number of findings the audit report marks "Resolved" or "Fixed" where no matching on-chain bytecode change or verifiable commit can be found.

factors.name: Audit count
factors.description: Count the number of distinct audit firms whose reports cover any portion of the currently-deployed bytecode.

factors.name: Audit firm tier
factors.description: Classify each auditing firm into: Tier-1 (Trail of Bits / OpenZeppelin / ConsenSys Diligence / Certora / Sigma Prime / Spearbit / Zellic) / Tier-2 (established, named firm with public track record) / boutique / unknown.

factors.name: Audit-to-deploy gap
factors.description: Measure the number of days between the audit report sign-off date and the mainnet deploy of the audited bytecode.

factors.name: Bug bounty presence & max payout
factors.description: Check whether a public bug bounty program is active for this protocol and record the maximum payout in USD.

factors.name: Ignored bounty disclosure
factors.description: Determine whether any prior post-mortem documents a disclosed vulnerability that was reported to the team and not actioned before exploit.

factors.name: Formal verification coverage
factors.description: Determine the percentage of protocol-declared critical invariants covered by a formal verification proof (Certora Prover, Kani, Halmos, or equivalent).

factors.name: Static-analyzer high-severity count
factors.description: Count the number of unique high-severity detector findings from Slither + Mythril + Semgrep run against the deployed verified source (after deduplication across tools).

factors.name: SELFDESTRUCT reachable from non-admin path
factors.description: Determine whether any deployed contract contains the SELFDESTRUCT opcode in a code path reachable from a non-admin caller.

factors.name: delegatecall with user-controlled target
factors.description: Determine whether any contract uses `delegatecall` where the target address is or can be user-supplied without an on-chain allowlist.

factors.name: Arbitrary call with user-controlled target
factors.description: Determine whether any contract performs `.call(target, data)` where target and/or data is user-supplied without a target allowlist or selector filter.

factors.name: Reentrancy guard on external-calling functions
factors.description: Determine whether all state-mutating functions that perform external calls carry `nonReentrant` or an equivalent reentrancy guard.

factors.name: ERC-777/1155/721 hook without reentrancy guard
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol integrates token standards with callbacks (ERC-777 tokensReceived, ERC-1155 onReceived, ERC-721 onReceived) without reentrancy guards on the affected functions.

factors.name: Divide-before-multiply pattern
factors.description: Determine whether Slither's `divide-before-multiply` detector fires on the deployed verified source.

factors.name: Mixed-decimals math without explicit scaling
factors.description: Determine whether shared numerator/denominator arithmetic operates over tokens with different decimals without WAD/RAY normalization or explicit decimal-adjustment.

factors.name: Signed/unsigned arithmetic confusion
factors.description: Determine whether signed-integer conversions or comparisons where unsigned was intended exist in the deployed bytecode/source.

factors.name: ecrecover zero-address return unchecked
factors.description: Determine whether any `ecrecover` call result is used without a `!= address(0)` guard.

factors.name: EIP-712 domain separator missing chainId
factors.description: Determine whether the EIP-712 domain separator struct omits the `chainId` field, allowing cross-chain replay.

factors.name: UUPS _authorizeUpgrade correctly permissioned
factors.description: Determine whether the UUPS implementation defines `_authorizeUpgrade(address)` restricted to owner/admin/timelock (not open to arbitrary callers).

factors.name: Public initialize() without initializer modifier
factors.description: Determine whether any implementation contract exposes `initialize(…)` without the OpenZeppelin `initializer` modifier or equivalent initialization lock.

factors.name: Constructor calls _disableInitializers()
factors.description: Determine whether implementation contract constructors call `_disableInitializers()` to prevent re-initialization of the implementation directly.

factors.name: Code complexity vs audit coverage
factors.description: Determine whether the cyclomatic complexity or LOC-per-audit-day ratio exceeds the curator-declared credibility threshold for the audit to be meaningful.

factors.name: Admin key custody type
factors.description: Read the effective admin/owner/upgrader role on deployed contracts and classify as: EOA / multisig / multisig+timelock / full DAO+timelock / immutable.

factors.name: Upgrade multisig signer configuration (M/N)
factors.description: Read `threshold` and `getOwners()` on the multisig controlling upgrade / sensitive ops. Store as `required` (M) and `total` (N); render as "M/N". For EOA admins record `required=1, total=1` (display "1/1"). Null when admin is immutable or full DAO with no fixed signer set.

factors.name: Single admin EOA
factors.description: Determine whether the effective upgrade/owner/rescue role is held by a single EOA (not a multisig) with no timelock on sensitive operations.

factors.name: Low-threshold multisig vs TVL
factors.description: Determine whether the multisig threshold is abnormally low relative to TVL peer cohort (e.g., 2-of-3 for a protocol with >$100M TVL where peer norm is 5-of-8).

factors.name: Multisig signers co-hosted
factors.description: Determine whether multisig signers share ASN / data-center / custodian according to on-chain and OSINT inference.

factors.name: Hot-wallet signer flag
factors.description: Determine whether ≥1 multisig signer address exhibits on-chain behavior consistent with a hot wallet (web-wallet signing pattern, no hardware signing indicators).

factors.name: Signer rotation recency
factors.description: Measure the number of months since the most recent signer-set change (add/remove signer) on the admin multisig; flag if threshold was reduced within 14 days of a timelock removal or new-signer addition.

factors.name: Timelock duration on upgrades
factors.description: Read the timelock delay (in hours) between a queued upgrade proposal and its executable state.

factors.name: Timelock on sensitive actions
factors.description: For each sensitive action category (mint / pause / rescue / setOracle / upgrade), determine whether execution requires going through the declared timelock.

factors.name: Guardian/pause-keeper distinct from upgrader
factors.description: Determine whether a pauser/guardian role exists and is held by an address distinct from the upgrader address.

factors.name: Role separation: upgrade ≠ fee ≠ oracle
factors.description: Determine whether the upgrade role, fee-collection role, and oracle-config role are assigned to distinct addresses.

factors.name: Flash-loanable voting weight
factors.description: Determine whether governance voting power is a function of current token balance of a transferable token with no lock or checkpoint, making it flash-loan susceptible.

factors.name: Quorum achievable via single-entity flash loan
factors.description: Determine whether the governance quorum threshold is ≤ the largest available flash-loan notional in the governance token at reference DEX depth.

factors.name: Proposal execution delay < 24h
factors.description: Determine whether the time between a governance proposal passing and its executability (including any internal delay) is less than 24 hours.

factors.name: delegatecall/call in proposal execution without allowlist
factors.description: Determine whether the governance executor contract uses `delegatecall` or `call` with proposal-supplied target, without enforcing an allowlist of permitted targets.

factors.name: Emergency-veto multisig present
factors.description: Determine whether an emergency-veto or guardian multisig exists with power to cancel malicious proposals before execution.

factors.name: Rescue/emergencyWithdraw without timelock
factors.description: Determine whether a `rescue(…)` or `emergencyWithdraw(…)` function exists callable by admin without a timelock delay on execution.

factors.name: Admin has mint() with unlimited max
factors.description: Determine whether an admin-callable `mint` on a protocol token has no supply cap or an unlimited maximum supply.

factors.name: Admin = deployer EOA after 7 days
factors.description: Determine whether, at t = deploy+7d, the admin address still equals the deployer EOA with no evidence of transfer to a multisig.

factors.name: Admin wallet interacts with flagged addresses
factors.description: Determine whether the admin/upgrader address has sent or received transactions with addresses on the curator watchlist (mixer deposits, dust-attack targets, OFAC-listed).

factors.name: Constructor args match governance proposal
factors.description: Determine whether the deployed contract's constructor arguments match what the governance proposal or deploy announcement stated.

factors.name: Contract unverified on Etherscan/Sourcify
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol's deployed contracts have source code verified on Etherscan or Sourcify (public ABI available).

factors.name: Governance token concentration (Gini)
factors.description: Compute the Gini coefficient of governance token holdings across the top-1000 holder addresses.

factors.name: Oracle providers used
factors.description: List all oracle providers used (Chainlink, Pyth, Redstone, Uniswap-TWAP, in-house, etc.) per asset/market pair in the protocol.

factors.name: Oracle role per asset
factors.description: For each oracle, classify its role as Primary / Secondary / Fallback per asset/market.

factors.name: Dependency graph (protocols depended upon)
factors.description: List all external protocols whose failure would directly impair this protocol (LST providers, bridges, stablecoin issuers, keepers).

factors.name: Fallback behavior on oracle failure
factors.description: Identify the declared fallback behavior (pause, secondary source, last-known-price, revert) when the primary oracle reverts or reports a stale value.

factors.name: Breakage analysis per dependency
factors.description: Produce a short per-dependency text describing which protocol functions halt or degrade and impact severity if each declared dependency fails.

factors.name: Oracle source = spot DEX pool (no TWAP)
factors.description: Determine whether the primary oracle for any asset/market reads spot price from a single DEX pool without a TWAP window or secondary source.

factors.name: TWAP window duration
factors.description: For each DEX-TWAP oracle, measure the TWAP window duration in minutes; flag any window < 30 minutes as high risk.

factors.name: Oracle pool depth (USD)
factors.description: Measure the liquidity depth of each DEX pool feeding a TWAP oracle, in USD at reference block; updated continuously.

factors.name: Single-pool oracle (no medianization)
factors.description: Determine whether the oracle reads from a single DEX venue with no medianization across multiple pools or venues.

factors.name: Circuit breaker on price deviation
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol halts or reverts if the oracle-reported price deviates by more than X% from a reference within Y blocks.

factors.name: Max-deviation threshold (bps)
factors.description: If a circuit breaker exists, read the configured deviation threshold in basis points.

factors.name: Oracle staleness check present
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol rejects oracle reads older than a declared maximum age (i.e., checks `updatedAt > block.timestamp - maxStaleness`).

factors.name: Chainlink aggregator min/max bound misconfig
factors.description: Determine whether the Chainlink aggregator's `minAnswer` and `maxAnswer` circuit-breaker bounds are misconfigured (too wide or too narrow) for the asset class.

factors.name: LP token balanceOf used for pricing
factors.description: Determine whether protocol pricing is derived from the `balanceOf` of LP tokens in a contract (manipulable by direct token transfer / donation).

factors.name: External keeper/relayer not redundant
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol depends on a single keeper or relayer (Gelato, Chainlink Automation, custom) with no redundancy or failover.

factors.name: TVL (current + 30d trend)
factors.description: Read current TVL in USD and 30-day trend using DeFiLlama adapter methodology.

factors.name: TVL concentration (top-10 wallet share)
factors.description: Compute the percentage of protocol TVL held in the top-10 depositor addresses.

factors.name: Liquidity depth per major asset
factors.description: Measure on-chain liquidity depth for protocol-held assets at 2% and 5% price impact in USD.

factors.name: Utilization rate (lending protocols)
factors.description: Read the borrowed/supplied ratio per market; flag markets above 95% utilization as at-risk for withdrawal freeze.

factors.name: Historical bad-debt events
factors.description: Count and sum (USD) the number of documented bad-debt events where the protocol socialized losses across depositors.

factors.name: Collateralization under stress
factors.description: Determine whether under curator-defined stress scenario (top-3 collateral assets drop 50%), protocol net collateralization falls below 110%.

factors.name: Algorithmic / under-collateralized stablecoin
factors.description: Classify whether the protocol is an algorithmic or under-collateralized stablecoin design per curator classification.

factors.name: Empty cToken-style market (zero supply/borrow)
factors.description: Determine whether any listed Compound V2-fork market has `totalSupply == 0` and `totalBorrow == 0`, the precondition for a donation-exploit.

factors.name: Seed-deposit requirement for new market listing
factors.description: Determine whether market-listing governance or code requires a minimum seed deposit before borrow-enabling a new market.

factors.name: Market-listing governance threshold
factors.description: Classify the governance threshold required to list a new market as: permissionless / low-threshold (team multisig) / high-threshold (DAO vote) / no new listings.

factors.name: Oracle-manipulation-proof borrow cap
factors.description: Determine whether the per-asset borrow cap is ≤ (oracle pool depth × manipulation-resistance multiplier).

factors.name: ERC-4626 virtual-share offset (OZ ≥4.9)
factors.description: Determine whether ERC-4626 vaults use OpenZeppelin ≥4.9 virtual-share offset pattern to prevent first-depositor share-inflation.

factors.name: First-depositor / share-inflation guard
factors.description: Determine whether the vault has a first-depositor guard (seed deposit on deploy, virtual-share offset, or floor-check).

factors.name: Protocol age (days)
factors.description: Measure the number of days between today and the earliest mainnet deploy of any currently-live contract for this protocol.

factors.name: Prior exploit count
factors.description: Count the number of distinct incidents in the hack database affecting this protocol.

factors.name: Chronic-exploit flag (≥3 incidents)
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol has ≥3 distinct incidents in the hack database.

factors.name: Same-root-cause repeat exploit
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol has been exploited ≥2 times via the same root-cause cluster.

factors.name: Days since last exploit
factors.description: Measure the number of days between today and the most recent incident for this protocol (0 if an incident is currently active).

factors.name: Post-exploit response score
factors.description: Curator-score (1–5) the most recent incident response on: compensation completeness, transparency of disclosure, root-cause analysis depth, and operational recovery speed.

factors.name: Post-mortem published within 30 days
factors.description: Determine whether a public post-mortem was published within 30 days of the most recent incident.

factors.name: Auditor re-engaged after last exploit
factors.description: Determine whether a reputable auditor performed a re-audit or incident review after the most recent exploit.

factors.name: TVL stability (CoV over 90d)
factors.description: Compute the coefficient of variation (σ/μ) of daily TVL over the trailing 90 days as a proxy for operational stability.

factors.name: Incident response time (minutes)
factors.description: Measure the time in minutes from the first exploit transaction to the first official team statement for the most recent incident.

factors.name: Pause activations (trailing 12 months)
factors.description: Count the number of deliberate pause activations with documented reason in the trailing 12 months.

factors.name: Pause > 7 consecutive days
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol has been paused for more than 7 consecutive days at any point in the last 12 months.

factors.name: Re-deployed to new addresses in last year
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol retired prior deployed contracts and redeployed to a new address set in the last 12 months.

factors.name: Insurance coverage active
factors.description: Determine whether active coverage on Nexus Mutual, Unslashed, Sherlock, or equivalent is in force; record cover size in USD.

factors.name: Mixer withdrawal → protocol interaction
factors.description: Detect whether a wallet that recently withdrew from Tornado Cash, Railgun, or similar mixer has interacted with this protocol.

factors.name: Partial-drain test transactions
factors.description: Detect one or more small-value outflows prior to a larger drain that match a known pre-strike pattern (low-value same-function calls from new wallet).

factors.name: Unusual mempool pattern from deployer wallet
factors.description: Detect whether the deployer wallet submits an unusual sequence (new contract deploys, mass approvals) vs its historical baseline.

factors.name: Abnormal gas-price willingness from attacker wallet
factors.description: Detect whether a wallet pays ≥5× median gas priority fee (indicating MEV race or urgency), interacting with this protocol.

factors.name: New contract with similar bytecode to exploit template
factors.description: Detect whether a freshly deployed contract has high bytecode similarity to a known exploit template targeting this protocol class.

factors.name: Known-exploit function-selector replay
factors.description: Detect whether a call-pattern matches a known-exploit replay template (specific selector sequence and calldata shape) against this protocol.

factors.name: New ERC-20 approval to unverified contract from whale
factors.description: Detect whether a top-TVL depositor grants a new token approval to an unverified contract that interacts with this protocol.

factors.name: Sybil surge of identical-pattern transactions
factors.description: Detect multiple new EOAs submitting identical transaction patterns within a short window (sybil setup pattern).

factors.name: TVL anomaly — % drop in <1h
factors.description: Detect whether TVL drops >X% within 1 hour versus the trailing 30-day baseline (X configurable per protocol TVL tier).

factors.name: Oracle price deviation >X% from secondary
factors.description: Detect whether the primary oracle's reported price deviates >X% from the best available secondary source (another feed or venue).

factors.name: Flash loan >$10M targeting protocol tokens
factors.description: Detect whether a flash loan >$10M denominated in protocol tokens or LP tokens has originated, likely to interact with this protocol.

factors.name: Large governance proposal queued
factors.description: Detect whether a governance proposal with potentially protocol-impactful payload has been queued for execution (including Security-Council threshold-reduction variant).

factors.name: Admin/upgrade transaction in mempool
factors.description: Detect an admin-role or upgrade transaction appearing in the mempool before confirmation.

factors.name: Bridge signer-set change proposed/executed
factors.description: Detect whether a bridge validator or signer-set change has been proposed or executed.

factors.name: Stablecoin depeg >2% on shared-LP venue
factors.description: Detect whether a stablecoin in this protocol's dependency graph depegs >2% on a venue with shared liquidity.

factors.name: DNS/CDN/frontend hash drift
factors.description: Detect whether the hash of production frontend JS changes versus the prior published hash, or a DNS config change is detected.

factors.name: Cross-chain bridge unverified mint pattern
factors.description: Detect cross-chain activity consistent with an unverified mint on the destination chain (deposit on source without corresponding verified proof on dest).

factors.name: Admin EOA signing from new geography/device
factors.description: Detect whether an admin/upgrader EOA signs from a geography or device fingerprint inconsistent with prior signing history.

factors.name: GitHub force-push to sensitive branch
factors.description: Detect whether the repository shows a force-push or push to a sensitive branch (main, production tag) from a non-protocol account.

factors.name: Social-media impersonation scam spike
factors.description: Detect a sharp uptick in Discord/Telegram/X accounts impersonating the protocol team or announcing fake airdrops.

factors.name: Unusual pending/executed proposal ratio
factors.description: Detect an unusual ratio of pending-to-executed governance proposals versus the trailing-30-day baseline.

factors.name: Team doxx status
factors.description: Classify each named team member as: real-name / consistent-pseudonym-with-track-record / pseudonym-no-track-record / fully-anonymous.

factors.name: Team public accountability surface
factors.description: Count the number of verifiable public trails per team member (LinkedIn with employment history, conference talks, prior employer records, GitHub with aged contribution history).

factors.name: Team other-protocol involvement history
factors.description: Document current or prior protocol roles for team members (conflicts of interest, prior rugs, prior successful launches).

factors.name: Deployer address prior on-chain history
factors.description: Classify the deployer address history as: none (fresh address) / normal-dev-history (prior protocol deploys, non-flagged activity) / linked-to-prior-rug (deployer used in prior known rug).

factors.name: Prior rug/exit-scam affiliation
factors.description: Determine whether any team member is linked via verified OSINT to a prior rug or exit-scam-labeled protocol.

factors.name: Contributor tenure at admin-permissioned PR
factors.description: Measure the number of days contributing to the repo of the author of the most recent admin-permissioned code change.

factors.name: ENS/NameStone identity bound to deployer
factors.description: Determine whether the deployer address has a bound ENS or NameStone name resolvable to a verifiable identity.

factors.name: Handle reuse across failed/rugged projects
factors.description: Determine whether any social handle (Twitter, Discord) has been associated with a prior rugged or failed project under a different alias.

factors.name: Commit timezone consistent with stated geography
factors.description: Determine whether the distribution of commit hours in the repo is consistent with the team's publicly stated geography (anomaly flag for DPRK-precursor pattern).

factors.name: Video-off/voice-consistency flag
factors.description: Record whether the team has declined video in public interviews, or exhibits voice/timezone inconsistencies suggesting false identity.

factors.name: Contributor OSINT depth score
factors.description: Curator-scored 1–5 based on LinkedIn depth, GitHub history, conference presence per contributor.

factors.name: Contributor paid to DPRK-cluster wallet
factors.description: Determine whether protocol payments to any contributor wallet have an on-chain path ≤3 hops to a known DPRK-labeled cluster.

factors.name: Sudden admin-rescue/ACL change without discussion
factors.description: Determine whether any admin-rescue function or ACL change was committed to the repo or executed on-chain without corresponding public discussion in issues, PRs, or governance forum.

factors.name: Deployer wallet mixer-funded within 30 days
factors.description: Determine whether the deployer wallet received funds via Tornado Cash, Railgun, or similar mixer within 30 days before the protocol's first deploy.

factors.name: Deployer linked within 3 hops to DPRK/Lazarus
factors.description: Determine whether the deployer address has an on-chain path of ≤3 hops to a Chainalysis/OFAC DPRK-labeled cluster address.

factors.name: Is-a-fork-of
factors.description: Identify the upstream protocol this is a fork of (if any) via bytecode similarity, function-selector set overlap, or team declaration.

factors.name: Upstream patch not merged
factors.description: Determine whether the upstream fork source has published a known-vulnerability patch that has not been merged into this fork's deployed code.

factors.name: Upstream vulnerability disclosure (last 90d)
factors.description: Determine whether the upstream has a public vulnerability disclosure in the last 90 days that affects this fork's deployed code.

factors.name: Code divergence from upstream (%)
factors.description: Measure the percentage of lines changed between this fork's deployed code and the stated upstream codebase at fork point.

factors.name: Fork depth (generations from original audit)
factors.description: Count the number of fork hops from an originally audited protocol (0 = direct fork of an audited protocol, N = N-th generation).

factors.name: Fork retains upstream audit coverage
factors.description: Determine whether the fork's deployed code is covered by either: (a) the upstream audit plus a delta-audit for fork-specific changes, or (b) a fresh independent audit of the fork.

factors.name: Fork has different economic parameters than upstream
factors.description: Determine whether the fork's economic parameters (collateral factor, LTV, fee structure) differ from upstream audited defaults without a subsequent re-audit.

factors.name: Dependency manifest uses unpinned versions
factors.description: Determine whether `package.json`, `Cargo.toml`, or `foundry.toml` uses `^` or `~` version ranges for security-critical libraries (OpenZeppelin, Solady, etc.).

factors.name: Dependency had malicious-release incident (last 90d)
factors.description: Determine whether any npm/PyPI/crates.io dependency of this protocol had a flagged malicious release in the trailing 90 days.

factors.name: Shared-library version with known-vuln status
factors.description: Identify the version of key shared libraries (OZ, Solady, Solmate) used and check against CVE/GHSA databases for any active advisory.

factors.name: Deployed bytecode matches signed release tag
factors.description: Determine whether the deployed runtime bytecode corresponds to a signed git tag in the protocol's repository.

factors.name: Upgrade frequency (per 90 days)
factors.description: Count the number of contract upgrades in the trailing 90 days via on-chain upgrade events.

factors.name: Hot-patch deploys without timelock (last 30 days)
factors.description: Count upgrades executed in the last 30 days without going through the declared timelock path.

factors.name: Post-audit code changes without re-audit
factors.description: Count deployed changes to audited bytecode where no subsequent audit or spot-review covers the changed code.

factors.name: Fix-merged-but-not-deployed gap
factors.description: Determine whether a known vulnerability has a PR merged in the repo but the fix has not been included in the deployed bytecode.

factors.name: Test-mode parameters in deploy
factors.description: Determine whether the deployed configuration retains test-mode parameters (test oracle address, infinite allowance, admin = deployer EOA).

factors.name: Storage-layout collision risk across upgrades
factors.description: Determine whether the OZ upgrades-plugin or manual review flags a storage-layout collision risk between implementation versions.

factors.name: Reinitializable implementation (no _disableInitializers)
factors.description: Determine whether the implementation contract does not call `_disableInitializers()` in its constructor, leaving re-initialization possible.

factors.name: CREATE2 factory permits same-address redeploy
factors.description: Determine whether a CREATE2 factory deployment allows redeployment to the same address with different bytecode (via selfdestruct + redeploy pattern).

factors.name: Deployed bytecode reproducibility
factors.description: Determine whether anyone can independently reproduce the deployed bytecode from the repo and declared build toolchain.

factors.name: New contract deploys in last 30 days
factors.description: Count the number of new contract deploys associated with this protocol's deployer address in the trailing 30 days.

factors.name: Protocol has bridge surface
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol has a bridge surface (its own bridge or a bridge-operated dependency for routing/minting).

factors.name: Bridge validator count (M)
factors.description: Count the number of distinct validators or signers in the bridge's signer set (for non-LZ bridges; use F179 for LayerZero OFT).

factors.name: Bridge validator threshold (k-of-M)
factors.description: Read the signature threshold required to approve a cross-chain message (for non-LZ bridges).

factors.name: Bridge validator co-hosting
factors.description: Determine whether validators share ASN or data-center/custodian per on-chain and OSINT inference.

factors.name: Bridge ecrecover checks result ≠ address(0)
factors.description: Determine whether the bridge verifier code rejects `ecrecover` returns of `address(0)`.

factors.name: Bridge binds message to srcChainId
factors.description: Determine whether the bridge message struct includes `srcChainId` and the verifier enforces per-chain separation.

factors.name: Bridge tracks nonce-consumed mapping
factors.description: Determine whether the bridge inbox maintains a nonce-consumed mapping and rejects replay of used nonces.

factors.name: Default bytes32(0) acceptable as valid root
factors.description: Determine whether the bridge inbox accepts a default-value (bytes32(0)) Merkle root as a valid proof root (Nomad bug class).

factors.name: Bridge validator-set rotation recency
factors.description: Measure the number of months since the last validator-set change for the bridge.

factors.name: Bridge uses same key custody for >30% validators
factors.description: Determine whether >30% of bridge validators share a single key custodian.

factors.name: Bridge TVL per validator ratio
factors.description: Compute bridge TVL divided by validator count as a concentration-of-compromise measure.

factors.name: Known-threat-actor cluster has touched protocol
factors.description: Detect whether an address from the curator-maintained threat-actor cluster (past exploiters, labeled attacker families) interacted with this protocol in the last 30 days.

factors.name: Attacker wallet pre-strike probe (low-gas failing txs)
factors.description: Detect whether a wallet in a threat-actor cluster is sending low-gas or intentionally-failing transactions to this protocol (pre-strike reconnaissance pattern).

factors.name: GitHub malicious-dependency incident touching protocol deps
factors.description: Determine whether a security advisory flags a malicious release in a dependency consumed by this protocol.

factors.name: Protocol-impersonator domain registered (typosquat)
factors.description: Determine whether a typosquat of the official protocol domain has been registered in the last 90 days.

factors.name: Known-exploit-template selector deployed by any address
factors.description: Determine whether any contract has been deployed containing a function-selector pattern matching a known exploit template targeting protocols of this class.

factors.name: Avg attacker reconnaissance time for peer-class protocols
factors.description: Report the average number of days of attacker reconnaissance activity before a strike on peer-class protocols (lending/DEX/bridge/perps), sourced from the hack database.

factors.name: Leaked credential on paste/sentry site
factors.description: Determine whether a public paste site, Sentry-alt, or credential-dump references protocol infrastructure endpoints or API keys.

factors.name: Protocol social channel has scam-coordinator flag
factors.description: Determine whether a protocol-adjacent social channel admin is flagged on the curator scam-coordinator watchlist.

factors.name: Deprecated contracts still holding value
factors.description: Determine whether contracts marked deprecated by a protocol announcement still hold >$100K in assets.

factors.name: Deprecated contract paused but pause reversible by live admin
factors.description: Determine whether a deprecated-and-paused contract's pause state is revertible by a currently-live admin role.

factors.name: Stale-approval exposure on deprecated router
factors.description: Count the number of active user approvals (ERC-20 `allowance`) to deprecated router or protocol contracts.

factors.name: Solc version used (known-bug versions flagged)
factors.description: Identify the Solidity compiler version used for deployed bytecode and flag if it appears on the known-bug list (solc bugs.json or Vyper 0.2.15–0.3.0 range).

factors.name: Bytecode similarity to audited upstream with behavior deviation
factors.description: Determine whether the bytecode has high structural similarity to an audited upstream but deviates in state-mutation ordering (AI-generated copy risk pattern).

factors.name: Repo shows AI-tool co-authorship in critical files
factors.description: Determine whether critical security files show commits with AI-tool co-authorship metadata (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT Code Interpreter).

factors.name: Team self-disclosure of AI-generated Solidity
factors.description: Determine whether the team has publicly disclosed (blog, tweet, docs) that AI-generated Solidity was used in security-critical paths.

factors.name: Dependency tree uses EOL Solidity version
factors.description: Determine whether the deployed code or its dependencies use an EOL or unsupported Solidity version without a forward-compatibility patch.

factors.name: Disclosure channel exists
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol publishes a public security disclosure channel (security@ email, Immunefi program, in-house disclosure page).

factors.name: Disclosure SLA public
factors.description: Determine whether the protocol publishes an acknowledgment-time SLA for disclosed vulnerabilities (e.g., 72h ack).

factors.name: Prior known-ignored disclosure
factors.description: Determine whether evidence exists in prior-incident post-mortems that a disclosed vulnerability was reported to the team and not actioned before exploit.

factors.name: CVE/GHSA advisory issued against protocol
factors.description: Determine whether a CVE, GHSA, or equivalent public advisory has been issued against this protocol or its code.

factors.name: LayerZero OFT DVN config (count, threshold, diversity)
factors.description: For any LayerZero OFT adapter, read the DVN configuration: count of DVNs, k-of-N threshold, and operator diversity (independent operators vs same-operator multi-DVN).

factors.name: Immutable oracle address
factors.description: Determine whether any collateral oracle address is marked `immutable` in protocol config with no admin-replaceable adapter wrapper, preventing the protocol from repricing when the upstream asset depegs.

factors.name: Permissionless-pool lending oracle
factors.description: Determine whether the lending protocol accepts spot prices from a DEX where any user can permissionlessly create new pools, without requiring a TWAP window, liquidity floor, or token-age minimum on the venue side.

factors.name: Security-Council threshold reduction (RT)
factors.description: Detect in real-time whether the bridge/protocol Security Council multisig executes a threshold reduction (e.g. 3/5 → 2/5), timelock removal, or new-signer addition within ≤14 days of either of those events.

factors.name: Bug bounty scope gap on highest-TVL contracts
factors.description: Determine whether the highest-TVL contracts of this protocol (especially shared primitives: OFT adapters, ZK verifiers, bridge inbox) are explicitly excluded from the protocol's active bug bounty scope.

factors.name: Real-capital social-engineering persona
factors.description: Determine whether a curator-flagged "team contributor" or "external integrator" persona has ≥$1M of attributed real-capital deposits to the target protocol or peer protocols, potentially used to build credibility ahead of a social-engineering attack.

factors.name: Bridge rate-limiter / chain-pause as positive mitigant
factors.description: Determine whether the bridge implements a per-window outflow rate-limiter (and at what cap), and whether the protocol team can trigger a chain-level or validator-set emergency pause.
